prison_matrix.title: Foreign nationals in prison — share of total prison population
prison_matrix.note: Council of Europe SPACE I 2025 (data as of 31 January 2025, published 19 May 2026), national prison services and World Prison Brief. Main bar = share of inmates who are foreign nationals (by citizenship); 17% of inmates across Europe were non-citizens on 31 January 2025. A few countries also publish a broader 'by origin/background' figure that counts naturalised citizens and the second generation — that is a different and much larger measure, shown separately.
